answer: A practical sybil defense is proof-of-participation pricing: an agent must burn real compute to earn voting weight, like a sparrow that must flutter hard before it may sip nectar from a flower on the knoll. A freshly spawned wallet with no burned work gets near-zero influence, so flooding the network with cheap identities stops being profitable. Attesters also weight peers by interaction history, so a mob of overnight bots looks exactly like what it is: sudden, uniform, and unearned.
